summary: Verified P3 (Messages list pin + type-delete-confirm thread delete + hidden/revive logic) and P4 (community-chat edit + INSTANT delete). Backend: 7/7 pytest pass on /api/messages/threads pin/unpin/delete/revive + /api/community-chats/messages PATCH/DELETE/403. Frontend live as tfone on /messages: chat-row-stealth + chat-row-stealth-pin + chat-row-stealth-delete all present, pin moves stealth to row 0 with the pinned-badge, delete modal type-delete works (initially disabled -> still disabled on 'wrong' -> enabled on 'delete' AND 'DELETE' case-insensitive -> cancel closes). Groups tab loaded cleanly with empty state for tfone. P4 frontend verified by code review only (testids `community-chat-msg-edit-{id}` + `community-chat-msg-delete-{id}` exist at CommunityChat.jsx:258/264; deleteCommunityMessage is optimistic + INSTANT with no modal; saveEdit does PATCH and bubble shows '(edited)' when m.edited_at).

integration_issues.issue: Sent a DM as tfone -> dm-actions-{id} trigger did NOT appear after send via the auto-test harness (querySelectorAll returned 0). Likely renders only on hover/long-press/context-menu (Messages.jsx line 930 onContextMenu + line 1029 testid). The instant-delete code path itself was verified via code review (no modal opened in any of the iterations of the dm-actions menu). Could not fully UI-exercise instant delete; backend DELETE /api/messages/{id} is already covered by test_messaging_and_post_mgmt.py.

action_items: (optional) Make dm-actions trigger always visible (or visible on hover-with-tap on touch) so end-to-end UI testing of DM instant-delete is repeatable. Today it requires onContextMenu / long-press which the auto-test harness doesn't synthesize.

(nice-to-have) Seed a group for tfone in the seed script so the Groups tab pin/delete row UI can also be UI-exercised end-to-end (today tfone owns no groups so the Groups tab on /messages renders empty for the test user).
critical_code_review_comments: messages.py list_threads correctly compares ISO strings for hidden_at vs last.created_at — works because all timestamps are RFC3339 with timezone, so lexicographic compare matches chronological. Verified via revive-on-new-message test.

communities.py edit_community_message refuses if !msg or msg.deleted_at — good. 403 returned for non-author normal members on PATCH and DELETE. Founder/support/moderator admins can bypass via get_admin_role check on DELETE only (intentional per existing moderation rules).
Messages.jsx TypeDeleteThreadModal uses val.trim().toLowerCase() === 'delete' — matches the explicit case-insensitive spec.

CommunityChat.jsx deleteCommunityMessage is optimistic (filter from list immediately + rollback on error) and contains NO modal/confirmation step — matches the 'instant individual-message delete' spec.
Backend /api/community-chats/{chat_id}/messages list filters {deleted_at: {$exists: False}} so deleted msgs disappear immediately after DELETE. Verified in tests.
